items_flat.title_en: OpenAI pauses frontier RL and strengthens monitoring after cyber-capability signals
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI因網路能力訊號暫停前沿RL並強化監控
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published “Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities,” stating it temporarily paused reinforcement learning on latest models intended for deployment for two weeks after the Hugging Face incident and preliminary evidence that its upcoming Astra model may meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold. The largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold while smaller-scale training and evaluations proceed; the company expanded workload isolation, continuous security testing, and multistage monitoring.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布《Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities》，指出因Hugging Face事件及即將推出的Astra模型可能達到「關鍵網路安全能力」門檻的初步證據，已對擬部署的最新模型暫停強化學習兩週。最大規模的前沿RL運行仍暫停，同時進行較小規模訓練與評估；公司強化了工作負載隔離、持續安全測試與多階段監控。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the clearest public admissions that internal cyber capability has forced a measurable slowdown in training cadence. Whether the pause is temporary operational hardening or a longer shift in deployment thresholds remains the key uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前最明確的公開承認：內部網路能力已迫使訓練節奏出現可量化的放緩。暫停是暫時的作業強化，還是部署門檻的長期調整，仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: We temporarily paused reinforcement learning (RL) training on our latest models intended for deployment for two weeks while we hardened and red-teamed our research environments and expanded monitoring coverage.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們對擬部署的最新模型暫時暫停強化學習（RL）訓練兩週，同時強化並紅隊測試研究環境，並擴大監控覆蓋範圍。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Teens with Study Mode and stronger default protections
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，內建學習模式與更強預設保護
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Teens, which automatically activates for users estimated under 18 or who state ages 13-17. It centers on learning support via Study Mode (guiding questions and step-by-step help), responsible homework reminders, and stronger default content and safety filters tailored for adolescents.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出ChatGPT for Teens，系統會自動為估計未滿18歲或自行聲明13-17歲的使用者啟用。產品以學習支援為核心，透過Study Mode提供引導式提問與逐步協助、負責任的作業提醒，以及針對青少年加強的預設內容與安全過濾。
items_flat.analysis_en: This formalizes teen-specific product and model behavior after years of real-world youth usage and external scrutiny. The combination of learning-first defaults and stronger under-18 safeguards addresses a persistent regulatory and parental pressure point, though long-term effectiveness will depend on age-estimation accuracy and enforcement consistency.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是在多年真實青少年使用與外部檢視後，正式將青少年專屬產品與模型行為產品化。以學習為優先的預設加上更強的18歲以下防護，回應了長期的監管與家長壓力，但長期成效仍取決於年齡估計準確度與執行一致性。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Teens, an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence. It provides stronger built-in safety protections for teens…
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT for Teens，這是一個協助青少年學習、批判性思考、深化理解，並有信心使用 AI 的體驗。它為青少年提供更強的內建安全保護……

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports Claude designs de novo protein binders at above-typical hit rates
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic報告Claude自主設計全新蛋白質結合劑，命中率高於業界典型水準
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published results showing Claude (Mythos Preview and Opus 4.8) autonomously designed protein binders against 15 targets, succeeding on 14. Wet-lab validation by Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience found hit rates of 22–35% depending on setup (vs typical 10–15%), with some designs binding tighter than prior published results. The company released the protocol prompt, design models, and binding data.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic發布結果顯示，Claude（Mythos Preview與Opus 4.8）自主針對15個目標設計全新蛋白質結合劑，成功14個。Adaptyv Bio與Twist Bioscience的濕實驗室驗證顯示，依設定不同命中率達22–35%（業界典型約10–15%），部分設計的結合力優於先前已發表結果。公司同步公開協議提示詞、設計模型與結合數據。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results move agentic protein design from in-silico claims to independently verified wet-lab outcomes and strengthen Anthropic’s life-sciences positioning. Access to the highest-capability models for broader scientific use remains gated, and binders are only an early step toward actual therapeutics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果將代理式蛋白質設計從純計算主張推進到經獨立驗證的濕實驗室成果，並強化Anthropic在生命科學的定位。最高能力模型對更廣泛科學用途的存取仍受限制，且結合劑僅是邁向真正治療藥物的早期步驟。
items_flat.quote: With a protein design prompt written by a human expert, Claude autonomously designed protein binders against 14 out of 15 targets.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在人類專家撰寫的蛋白質設計提示詞下，Claude自主針對15個目標中的14個設計出全新蛋白質結合劑。
